title: Nomad Snapshot, Cursor and Recovery Protocol
description: Snapshot schema, digest, last_applied_seq, resume request/result, gap and compaction boundary rules. No encryption fields. Source: CON-004, PRD SP-02, Validation 6.2.

snapshot_seq.description: Seq number up to which this snapshot is valid. All durable events with seq <= snapshot_seq are included in the snapshot.

digest.description: Cryptographic digest (SHA-256) of the serialized snapshot content. Used to verify reducer consistency.

digest_spec.scope: Entire snapshot object excluding the digest field and any non-schema metadata (e.g. notes).

pseudo_code: snapshot_without_digest = {k: v for k, v in snapshot.items() if k != 'digest'}

last_applied_seq.description: Last seq applied by the producing reducer. MUST equal snapshot_seq for a complete snapshot.

state_summary.description: Reduced state derived from all durable events up to snapshot_seq.

version.description: Contract version used to produce this snapshot.

invariants.rule: Only when the reducer output (digest, state_summary) matches the snapshot MAY the client transition to client_freshness=Live.
Snapshot replacement: a newer snapshot (higher snapshot_seq) replaces an older one. The digest MUST differ. Receivers MUST reject snapshot_seq rollback.

Gap handling: if events [last_applied_seq+1, gap_to_seq] are missing, the client is informed via ERR_GAP_DETECTED and the snapshot. Manual recovery or explicit degradation is required; auto-filling gaps is FORBIDDEN.

Compaction boundary: events with seq < compaction_boundary_seq are no longer available. The snapshot at compaction_boundary_seq is the authoritative state. Receivers MUST accept snapshot-based recovery without full event replay.
Version incompatibility: if client_version != snapshot version, ERR_VERSION_INCOMPATIBLE. The client goes read-only or blocks safe operations until upgraded.
Retention exceeded: if the client's last_applied_seq < compaction_boundary_seq - retention_window, ERR_RETENTION_EXCEEDED. Recovery is not possible; the client must start a new session.
Snapshot digest MUST cover all state_summary fields. Any tampering with state_summary changes the digest and is detected.

compaction_rules.description: Compaction removes old events but preserves the latest snapshot at the compaction boundary.
compaction_rules.trigger: When total event count exceeds retention threshold OR age exceeds retention window.
preserved: Metadata needed to verify the snapshot digest
removed: Events with seq < compaction_boundary_seq (except the snapshot)
